Divide the recurrence by \(S_n S_{n-1}\):

\[
\frac{k(S_n-S_{n-1})}{S_nS_{n-1}}=-1
\]

\[
k\left(\frac1{S_{n-1}}-\frac1{S_n}\right)=-1
\]

\[
\frac1{S_n}-\frac1{S_{n-1}}=\frac1k
\]

Thus \(\frac1{S_n}\) is arithmetic:

\[
\frac1{S_n}=\frac1{S_1}+\frac{n-1}{k}=1+\frac{n-1}{k}
\]

Using \(S_{99}=\frac1{50}\):

\[
50=1+\frac{98}{k}
\]

\[
\frac{98}{k}=49
\]

\[
k=2
\]

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
